sources.title: Россия – Швеция: из истории взаимоотношений
sources.institution: Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина
sources.coverage: Russian-Swedish documentary and cartographic materials, including the 1809 Fredrikshamn treaty scans and later boundary materials
sources.notes: The collection identifies the Fredrikshamn peace treaty as scans 141-156 and an additional 1817 act as scans 157-170. Individual document records must preserve exact scan ranges.

sources.title: Цифровые копии и описания дел Российского государственного исторического архива в Президентской библиотеке
sources.institution: Российский государственный исторический архив / Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина
sources.coverage: Digitized or catalogued RGIA archival files used for imperial territorial administration and boundary implementation
sources.notes: Each canonical record must cite its concrete RGIA fond/opis/delo/folios and exact President Library item URL. Copies are marked as copies where the catalog says so.
